div.head: Swer 2
div.ab: On ðone Drihten, þe ðes haligdom is fore halig, swa ic spæce drife mid fullan folcrihte, butan bræde 7 butan swice 7 butan æghwylcum facne, swa me forstolen wæs ðæt orf N., ðæt ic onspece 7 þæt ic mid N. befangen hæbbe.

[I swear] by the Lord before whom this relic is holy, [that] I pursue this case with full justice and without deceit or fraud and without any deception since these cattle (N.) for which I bring a claim were stolen from me, and which I [consequently) seized from N.

Ðus man sceal swerigean, þonne man hafð his æhte gebryid 7 bringeð hi on gange. On ðone Drihten, ðe ðæs haligdom is for eh, swa ic spæce drife mid fullan folcrihte, butan bræde 7 beswice 7 butan æghwilcum facne, swa me ðeofstolen wæs þæt orf N., þæt ic onspece 7 þæt ic mid Ñ. befangen hæbbe.
